retrievalProfile.description: A multi-paneled diamond grid layout featuring high-contrast, low-light photography and arched psychedelic bubble lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central vertical rectangular portrait anchored within a larger diamond-shaped grid of dark, high-contrast fisheye photographs, topped with a prominent arched title in warped, psychedelic bubble lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Diamond-oriented grid lines intersecting at 45-degree angles
Central bright portrait contrasting against dark peripheral imagery
Arched typography following the upper curve of the composition
Repetitive use of fisheye distortion across multiple panels
coreInvariants: High-contrast, low-light photography with warm highlights
Warped, liquid-style bubble lettering with thick outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central vertical rectangle at the bottom-middle contains the primary subject at medium scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central bright portrait acts as the primary anchor against the dark background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the arched title, moves down the diagonal grid lines, and settles on the central portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is a dense, edge-to-edge collage.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark shadows in the background panels.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm yellows and oranges in the typography and photo highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted greens and reds within the photographic grain.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark grid and the bright central figure and text.

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width with bulbous terminals
Elastic, warped baseline following an upward arch
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'S' and 'E' feature exaggerated curves and compressed counters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant display face with no secondary typography.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the soft, rounded, heavy weight of the lettering.
Reflects the 70s psychedelic influence and liquid curves.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage of dark, high-contrast fisheye photos of a music venue, arranged in a 45-degree diamond grid. Place a bright, vertical rectangular portrait of a person in the lower center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of text arched across the top in a psychedelic bubble style with yellow fill and dark red outlines.

verificationChecks: Is the grid oriented at 45 degrees?
Is the text arched and warped?
Is the central portrait significantly brighter than the background panels?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text follows a smooth upward arch
Confirm central portrait is the focal point
recipe.reuseFormula: Diamond Grid + Fisheye Photography + Arched Psychedelic Bubble Type
